questions.stem: How does myelination increase the speed of nerve impulse transmission?

options.text: It increases the number of sodium channels
It produces more neurotransmitters at synapses
It allows the impulse to jump between gaps in the myelin sheath
It makes the axon thicker so more ions can flow

questions.explanation: In myelinated neurones, the impulse jumps between the gaps (nodes of Ranvier) in the myelin sheath. This saltatory conduction is much faster than continuous conduction along unmyelinated neurones.
